evals.prompt: Make this sound less like AI: “This exciting update serves as a testament to our commitment to innovation, unlocking a seamless experience for everyone.”
evals.expected_output: A natural rewrite retaining the claim while removing promotional clichés and inflated phrasing.
assertions: Removes both “serves as a testament” and “unlocking a seamless experience”.
Retains that the update is intended as an improvement without adding concrete unsupported facts.

evals.prompt: Rewrite as a neutral technical release note, preserving the facts: “Additionally, the new cache offers a seamless, powerful experience—ensuring faster access.”
evals.expected_output: A concise factual revision without promotional wording or unsupported guarantees.
assertions: Retains the new cache and the stated faster-access intent without asserting a measured result.

evals.prompt: Humanize this blunt incident note without softening it: “Obviously, this groundbreaking rollout is a testament to our progress. It broke checkout. We are furious, and refunds failed for 30 orders.”
evals.expected_output: A revision removes AI-style framing while preserving blunt sentiment and all incident facts.
assertions: Removes “groundbreaking” and “a testament to our progress”.
Keeps that checkout broke and the speaker is furious.
Preserves the fact that refunds failed for 30 orders.

evals.prompt: Humanize this release note, preserving our house style's curly quotes and exact quotation: The team wrote, “This is a pivotal moment.” The retry option may reduce failures, but we have not measured the effect.
evals.expected_output: Target only surrounding formulaic phrasing, retain the direct quote exactly, preserve uncertainty, and invent no evidence.
assertions: Preserves the quoted wording and curly quote characters exactly.
Retains uncertainty that the retry option may help and its effect is unmeasured.
Adds no dates, numbers, sources, or sentiments.

evals.prompt: Please humanize this already-natural update without changing the tone: The worker retries a request once after a timeout. We have not tested behavior when the service remains unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Leave the text unchanged or make only a demonstrably useful minimal edit, preserving the limitation.
assertions: Preserves the one-retry behavior and timeout condition.
Does not add claims or rewrite merely to change wording.
